instruction: A clean, minimalist lifestyle photograph captured from a low angle wide shot. Inside a bright, white-walled yoga studio with large windows and wooden wall bars, two subjects perform yoga. In the foreground right, the young woman in the beige sports bra (R4) is in an upright pigeon pose, her torso lifted, head facing forward, and arms relaxed by her sides. Behind her to the left, the blonde girl in the beige long-sleeve top (R5) mirrors the pose, holding her torso upright with hands resting on the floor. They are aligned diagonally, performing the stretch in unison. Bright, soft natural light fills the space, creating a serene, neutral-toned atmosphere.
